definition: Robustly Optimized BERT Approach — a BERT retraining that removes NSP, trains longer on more data, and beats the original on most benchmarks (Liu et al., 2019).
details: Robustly Optimized BERT Approach — a BERT retraining that removes NSP, trains longer on more data, and beats the original on most benchmarks (Liu et al., 2019).

explainer.lead: RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Approach) is a BERT retraining that removes next-sentence prediction, trains longer on more data, and beats the original on most benchmarks.

tiers.eli5: Like taking the same car and tuning the engine — same design, but trained harder and longer so it performs better.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it as a drop-in replacement for BERT where stronger benchmark performance is wanted. The key change is dropping next-sentence prediction and training longer on more data.
tiers.paperLevel: A BERT retraining that removes NSP and trains longer on more data (Liu et al., 2019).

explainer.example: A team swaps BERT for RoBERTa in a text classifier and sees benchmark gains without changing the architecture.
